docs.title: reachy-mini-mcp
docs.text:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Reachy Mini — a thin REST wrapper around the Pollen daemon, exposed over MCP so any MCP-capable LLM frontend (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor) can read robot state and trigger motion without generating ad-hoc Python.

The canonical product specification lives in the claude-reachy-mini plugin repository under spec/reachy-mini/mcp-server/. This site documents the implementation that follows from that spec.

docs.title: Status
docs.text: Initial skeleton. Tier-1 / Tier-2 / Tier-3 tools are not yet implemented — only a health_check tool that probes daemon reachability and local audit-log writability.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
docker build -t reachy-mini-mcp:dev .
docker run --rm -i \
  --network host \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/reachy-mini-mcp:/home/mcp/.cache/reachy-mini-mcp" \
  reachy-mini-mcp:dev

See the README for MCP-client wiring and environment variables.
